geometry_diagnosis.insufficient_iou_cause: Gold annotations in OFAC span full table column cell width, while both extractors return tight textual bounding boxes.
geometry_diagnosis.port_fix_rationale: Free extractor also outputs tight word bounding boxes; cell expansion is already handled deterministically by fix_01 cell padding normalizer.

key_finding: Free spatial extractor (LiteParse) confirms that raw PDF text items are token-tight glyph boxes; the gap to gold is cell padding rather than OCR recognition.
